lifecycle.flow: 4 November 2026: every human input is taken once, at the start. A one-off goal plans, asks only what it could not find, agrees the deliverables and the template for each, then runs to the end by itself: findings accepted automatically, the top option chosen automatically, the deliverables built. A standing goal agrees the same at set-up plus the actions it may take; when it fires it runs, chooses, acts, builds and tells you. Anything can be changed afterwards; the deliverables are rebuilt as the next version.

panelTabs.rule: Always the same six tabs in the same order, from the first message to the last. A tab with nothing in it yet says what will land there. The panel opens on the tab that matters at that moment (Plan while briefing, Workflow while it runs, Deliverables when it is done); the order never changes.

contents.plan: Open points (Missing in orange until answered, then Clarified in green with the answer and where it came from), then the plan rows and the deliverables agreed
contents.workflow: The steps as a graph; a "working now" card per running step with its calls one by one, a progress bar and the seconds elapsed
contents.findings: Every finding (tagged "Accepted automatically"), its evidence and data, and all the options with "Why this" and "Use this instead". On a standing goal also the runs and the actions with their states
contents.deliverables: The deliverables, built part by part in front of you (a chip per deliverable: done, being built, waiting), then complete; download or open in Submissions

stages.reading: The agent reads what it was given and what is connected (about twenty seconds at normal pace). The feed in the chat shows one tool call per line; each line reveals plan rows. The composer is off. Ends with the steps drafted.
stages.questions: Your input, all of it in one step. Only what the reads could not find, one card at a time (kind 'q'); each answered point turns from Missing to Clarified on the Plan tab. Then the deliverables card (kind 'deliv'): the deliverables the goal suggests, ticked, and more offered unticked; add your own in words; for each the template, Recommended, From the library, Upload your own or Create one for me. A standing goal's card also sets each kind of action to By itself or Ask me first. One click: Run it, or Arm the watch.
stages.running: (once) No second agreement and no checkpoint. Steps run (about ten seconds each); findings land as steps finish; then findings accepted automatically (over['acc:<id>'] = 'auto'), the top option chosen automatically (chosenBy 'auto'), the deliverables built part by part (prog: {sids, i, shown}). Status 'delivered'; the goal moves to Executed.
stages.armed: (watch) Armed. Nothing runs until the rule fires or the schedule is due ("Simulate tonight’s load" or 'Simulate: run now' in the demo). On firing: a notification; status 'fired' while the steps run; then accept, choose, build and act by themselves: actions set to By itself are done, the others wait (state 'waiting') under Needs you until Approve or Leave it. Status 'executed'; a notification says what it found, what it chose and what it did. The watch stays armed.
stages.after: Look back, change anything: 'Use this instead' on another option, or a steer in the chat ("Leave Corrigan out of ferric": step 3 and everything after it re-run). Every deliverable is rebuilt as the next version (version, basis; the earlier version stays in the log). On a standing goal, what was done stays done and the new option's actions wait for your OK.
